meta.name: learn-codebase
meta.description: Prime a codebase by reading every source file in full. Use when starting work on a new or unfamiliar project, or when the user asks to "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速熟悉陌生代码库的完整结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚接手一个不熟悉的项目，需要快速理解代码全貌。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly understand the full structure of an unfamiliar codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just took over an unfamiliar project and need to grasp the codebase quickly.

howto.what: Claude 会完整阅读项目中的每一个源代码文件，从而深入理解整个代码库的结构和逻辑。
howto.when: 当你开始一个新项目、接手不熟悉的代码库，或说出“学习代码库”、“阅读代码库”、“初始化”等关键词时触发。

say.note: Claude 会开始逐文件阅读所有源代码。

say.text: 帮我熟悉这个项目，阅读所有源文件。
say.note: Claude 会完整读取代码库以建立理解。

howto.what_en: Claude will read every source file in the project to build a deep understanding of the codebase structure and logic.
howto.when_en: Triggered when starting a new project, working on an unfamiliar codebase, or when the user says "learn the codebase", "read the codebase", "prime", or "get up to speed".

say_en.note: Claude will start reading all source files.

say_en.text: Help me get familiar with this project by reading all source files.
say_en.note: Claude will fully read the codebase to build understanding.
